description: Composite layout with a central heatmap and two marginal histograms (top and right).

components.description: Main heatmap area composed of a dense grid of uniformly sized rectangular cells with varying fill intensity.
Top marginal histogram above the heatmap consisting of adjacent vertical bars.
Right marginal histogram alongside the heatmap consisting of stacked horizontal bars.

primary.explanation: About 10 binned columns of IMDB ratings across the x axis.

secondary.explanation: About 10 binned rows of Rotten Tomatoes ratings along the y axis.

primary.explanation: Top histogram with about 10 adjacent vertical bars (bins) distributed along x.
Right marginal histogram: one horizontal bar per binned Rotten Tomatoes rating (about 10 bins) arranged along y.
